_doc: BTH MERGE TIER MAP — the machine-readable gate. Read by .github/scripts/classify-pr.mjs, which the `gate` workflow runs on every PR. Tier A/B may auto-merge on green; Tier C/D always require Ty's approving review. Canonical doctrine copy: .claude/agent-system/router/merge-tiers.json. THIS repo copy is what CI actually executes.
_rules_of_evaluation: 1. If ANY changed path matches force_tier_d -> the PR is Tier D. This wins over everything and cannot be overridden.
2. Otherwise the PR's tier is the HIGHEST (most restrictive) tier across all its changed paths. D > C > B > A.
3. Any changed path that matches NO glob below is treated as Tier D. Unknown is never automatic — the map fails CLOSED.
4. Then the content scan runs on ADDED lines only. Any hit promotes the PR to at least Tier C, regardless of path.
5. Auto-merge additionally requires the repo variable BTH_AUTOMERGE == 'on'. Unset/anything else = every PR needs Ty.

force_tier_d._why: THE GATE CANNOT MODIFY ITSELF. Any PR that touches the gate's own machinery, the deploy identity, or the ignore rules is Tier D by construction — so an agent can never widen its own authority, and a green gate can never be manufactured by editing the gate.

B.label: Safe public — public but non-money, revertable in ~1 min

C.label: Money & conversion — public AND touches revenue, tracking, claims, or anything that sends
C._why: Every path here can cost money, break attribution, make a legal claim, or reach a real person. These are judgment calls, and judgment stays with Ty.

_path_notes.bth-operator-sw.js: The service worker. It served stale HTML site-wide once already (2026-06-16) — a bad SW poisons every page and survives a revert in users' browsers. Never automatic.
_path_notes.assets/bth-tracking.js: Pixels and conversion events. A drifted ID silently destroys attribution and every ad decision downstream.
_path_notes.email-sequences/**: These become REAL SENDS to real people. Unrecallable.
_path_notes.seo/**: Injury/pain content — medical-adjacent claims by nature. Compliance judgment, not a mechanical check.
_path_notes.updates/**: announcements.json is the public claims registry.

content_promote_to_c._why: Path rules alone can be defeated by moving a line into a 'safe' file. These patterns run against ADDED lines in the diff and promote the PR to Tier C no matter which file it landed in. Money and claims are caught by what the text SAYS, not where it lives.

rate_cap._why: A Tier-2 action performed 10,000 times produces a Tier-4 outcome. Volume is its own risk class, independent of any single change being safe.
rate_cap.on_exceed: gate fails — the next PR that day waits for Ty

kill_switch._how: Repository variable BTH_AUTOMERGE. Must equal the exact string 'on' for ANY auto-merge to happen. Unset, empty, or any other value = every PR requires Ty's approval, exactly as it works today.
kill_switch.set_it: gh variable set BTH_AUTOMERGE --body on  --repo builttohoop/BTH-website
kill_switch.kill_it: gh variable set BTH_AUTOMERGE --body off --repo builttohoop/BTH-website
